items.title: Cancellation No. 97-42 (SR-71, Operation and Maintenance, Air Force) and No. 97-43 (SR-71 Mods, Aircraft Procurement, Air Force): typed White House copies, in NSC Press Office files for the President's October 1997 South America trip
items.description: The typed reports attached to the President's special message of 14 October 1997. 97-42 cancels "$30,000 thousand for Operation and Maintenance, Air Force project 'SR-71' on page 75 of House Report 105-265" and states "There is no military requirement to continue to operate the SR-71"; 97-43 cancels "$9,000 thousand for Aircraft Procurement, Air Force, project 'SR-71 Mods' on page 103 of House Report 105-265" (cameras, radar processing, GPS and ELINT upgrades). PDF page 73 is the White House fact sheet 'President Clinton uses line-item veto on Defense Appropriations Act of 1998, October 14, 1997'.
items.creator: Executive Office of the President (Office of Management and Budget); filed in Philip "PJ" Crowley's files, National Security Council Office of Press and Communications (Clinton Administration), William J. Clinton Presidential Library
items.credit: William J. Clinton Presidential Library, National Archives (NAID 44169788)
items.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. 105) for the pages cited
items.rights_evidence: NARA catalog use restriction for the folder: "Restricted - Possibly", specific restriction "Copyright", note "Some or all of the records may be subject to copyright restrictions. Researchers should contact the copyright holder for further information." Access: "Restricted - Partly". The folder-level caution covers news clippings filed in it; the pages cited here are White House and OMB records (U.S. Government works, 17 U.S.C. 105). Folder title: 'POTUS [President of the United States] Trip to Venezuela, Brazil, and Argentina (October 12-18, 1997) [Folder 2] [3]', FOIA tracking LPWJC 2009-1155-F. The identical report text is printed in the Federal Register (62 FR 53704) as a government document.
items.resolution: 102-page PDF, 4.05 MB; SR-71 pages are PDF pp. 75 to 78 (97-42 on pp. 75 and 76, 97-43 on pp. 77 and 78); each a 300 dpi bitonal scan, 2523x3321 px
items.notes: Verified HTTP 200 (catalog page) and 206 (PDF, range request). The real page of the actual cancellation, as the brief asks for. Clinton signed the message in Brasilia during the trip, so no Oval Office signing photograph is expected for this cancellation.
